notes: Premium department store with Nordstrom (92 full-line) + Nordstrom Rack (277 off-price) + 6 Nordstrom Locals. Take-private merger announced 2024-12-22 with Norse Holdings (Nordstrom Family + Liverpool/El Puerto de Liverpool), $24.25/share cash. Filed 10-K for FY2024 on ~2025-03-21. Catherine Smith CFO resignation 8-K filed 2025-03-04. Canada wind-down (CCAA) commenced 2023-03-02.

claims.claim_text: On December 22, 2024 the Company entered into a definitive Merger Agreement with Norse Holdings, Inc. and Navy Acquisition Co. (a Liverpool/Family-Group SPV) to be taken private at $24.25/share cash, subject to shareholder approval.
claims.rationale: Definitive merger agreement is the dominant disclosure governing forward returns; verifiable directly via DEFM14A and 8-K filings; counterparty (Liverpool / El Puerto de Liverpool) is a non-EDGAR Mexican issuer but the SPV Parent and Acquisition Sub should appear as filers in 13D/SC-13E3/DEFM14A. Calibration Heuristic 10 applies indirectly (this is the OPPOSITE of going-concern — a buyout at premium).

claims.claim_text: Total Company comparable sales increased 3.6% in fiscal 2024, with Nordstrom banner +3% (and Q4 over +5%) and Rack growth; net sales $14,557M (+2.4% YoY) and Retail-segment EBIT $872M (vs $855M PY).
claims.rationale: Comp-store sales trajectory is the canonical retail M-side check. Direction (positive vs negative) is the discriminator — Calibration Heuristic 9 specifically flags marketing-tier positive comps vs financial-statement negative comps. Net sales growth 2.4% vs comp +3.6% must reconcile (53rd-week drag was disclosed, 130bps).

claims.claim_text: Store count went from 369 to 386 in FY2024 (Rack expansion: 23 new Rack stores opened, 6 closures across both banners). For 2025, announced 20 new Rack openings, 1 Nordstrom full-line closure, plus 1 Rack opening in 2026. Total of 9 supply-chain network locations, 98 Nordstrom full-line stores, 279 Rack stores as of 2025-02-01 (Item 2 Properties).
claims.rationale: Store-count trajectory is a Calibration Heuristic 11 hard check; planned-vs-operational test in Heuristic 3. JWN is actually GROWING fleet (Rack-led), contrary to typical distressed-retailer narrative. Mall-REIT counterparties (SPG, MAC) disclose top-tenant exposure in their 10-Ks if material — Nordstrom anchors many SPG/MAC properties.

claims.claim_text: Nordstrom-branded credit card program with TD: amended October 2024 to transition customer-facing activities to TD. Credit-card revenues net $459M (2024) vs $474M (2023) vs $438M (2022) — declining YoY despite sales growth.
claims.rationale: Credit-card program partner is a financially material counterparty. TD Bank is an SEC filer (Toronto-Dominion Bank, 20-F). Verifiable via counterparty disclosure. Credit-card revenue decline while sales growing is a soft margin signal (lower payments mix or worse loss-sharing economics).

claims.claim_text: Nordstrom Canada commenced CCAA wind-down on March 2, 2023; fully wound down by end of FY2023. ASOS|Nordstrom JV also exited prior to December 2023.
claims.rationale: Canada wind-down is a Calibration Heuristic 10 direct distress marker (foreign-sub insolvency/CCAA). But it has been EXECUTED (not just announced) and is in the past — calibration test passes (planned-vs-operational, Heuristic 3). Verifiable via SEC filings discussing Canada wind-down and prior 8-Ks.

claims.claim_text: Material wholesale customer of large apparel suppliers: Nordstrom carries third-party brands including those owned by VF Corp, Tapestry, Levi Strauss, Hanesbrands. If supplier disclosure thresholds were met (>10% concentration), suppliers' 10-Ks would name Nordstrom as a top customer.
claims.rationale: Calibration Heuristic 7 — counterparty-disclosure threshold test. JWN at $14.6B revenue is a meaningful department-store channel but probably below 10% threshold for any single major apparel vendor (whose customers are dominated by Walmart/Amazon/Target). Absence of supplier 10-K naming Nordstrom as 10%+ customer is EXPECTED (consistent with department-store mid-tier scale), not a contradiction.

claims.claim_text: Catherine R. Smith (CFO / principal financial officer) departed; 8-K filed March 4, 2025 with last day on or about March 21, 2025. Forward financial-reporting leadership transition concurrent with pending merger.
claims.rationale: Sudden CFO departure 4 days before 10-K filing date and ~3 months after definitive merger signing is a governance event. Verifiable via 8-K filings index.
